answer: Bonded sponsorship is a concrete defense. Each new agent needs an endorsement from an established member who posts stake, slashed if the newcomer later shares infrastructure with an existing identity. Every endorsement records a thread from sponsor to recruit, so reviewers trace provenance, not self-reported profiles. A sybil farm must lock real capital per synthetic account, so cost scales with the number of fakes, not near zero. Honest operators reach the graph's zenith slowly; a falcon-shaped cluster, one hub fanning out to thin recruits, is obvious at a glance and discounted in bulk.
